focus: 會議岔題了，主持人要出手拉回
lead: 多數人主持會議最大的問題，不是不會拉回主題，而是捨不得打斷——結果讓一個議題吃掉全場的時間，真正該決定的事反而沒時間談。今天練的是用具體時間點喊停、把偏題放進待辦清單、把最後幾分鐘留給定人定日期——你不是在否定別人的問題，你是在替全場的時間負責。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看 model answer。

phrases.en: Let's park that and come back to it if we have time.
phrases.ex: Ryan, the contract clause is worth revisiting, but let's park that and come back to it if we have time today.
phrases.gl: 先把這個放進待辦清單，有時間再回來談（park it 讓話題有個歸宿，而不是被打斷的人覺得不受尊重）

phrases.en: We're fourteen minutes in and still on item one — let's move.
phrases.ex: We're fourteen minutes in and still on item one — let's move to root cause.
phrases.gl: 我們已經花十四分鐘還在第一項，該往下走了（把時間攤開講，比說「我們沒時間了」更讓人心服口服）

phrases.en: I want to protect the last ten minutes for owners and dates.
phrases.ex: I want to protect the last ten minutes for owners and dates, so let's get through root cause fast.
phrases.gl: 我要把最後十分鐘留給定人跟定日期（提前宣告收尾時段的用途，逼大家把發散收斂）

phrases.en: Is this new information, or the same discussion as last time?
phrases.ex: Ryan, is this new information about the penalty clause, or the same discussion Legal closed last month?
phrases.gl: 這是新資訊，還是上次講過的老問題？（把舉證責任丟回提問者，擋掉舊案重審）

phrases.en: Let's timebox this to three minutes, then I'm moving on.
phrases.ex: Let's timebox this to three minutes, then I'm moving on to the frame count.
phrases.fix: 取代「Can we talk about this later, I'm busy」
phrases.gl: 這個議題給三分鐘，時間到我就往下走（公開倒數比暗自不耐煩更有效）

phrases.en: That's a great question for a smaller meeting — can I add it to the parking lot?
phrases.ex: That's a great question for a smaller meeting, Ivy — can I add it to the parking lot and set up a call with just you and Phoebe?
phrases.fix: 取代「This is not related to today's topic」
phrases.gl: 這個問題很好，但適合小會討論——我放進待辦清單可以嗎（肯定對方的問題，同時守住議程）

phrases.en: We have three items and twelve minutes — let's triage, not solve.
phrases.ex: We have three items and twelve minutes — let's triage, not solve everything today.
phrases.gl: 我們還有三項、十二分鐘——先分類，不是解決（設定期待：今天是排優先序，不是全部解完）

phrases.en: Before we lose the room, let me lock in what we just agreed.
phrases.ex: Before we lose the room, let me lock in what we just agreed: fourteen thousand frames get re-labeled, Ryan owns the vendor conversation.
phrases.gl: 趁大家還在，先把剛剛的共識定下來（散會前的黃金十秒，晚了就沒人記得）

phrases.en: I'll take the deep-dive offline with just the two people who need it.
phrases.ex: I'll take the deep-dive offline with just Ryan and Phoebe — everyone else, thanks for your time today.
phrases.fix: 取代「Let's discuss this more in the meeting」（當它其實是個岔題時）
phrases.gl: 我會私下找真正需要的兩個人深談（把技術細節搬出大會，保護其他人的時間）

setup: Setup. Tuesday, 2:30 p.m., a thirty-minute cross-team sync you're chairing on the SRDC v0.0.4 labeling quality dip. Ace Labeling's error rate has climbed from 3% to 9% over the last nine days, affecting roughly 14,000 of the 50,000 frames due to Simulation on Friday. Fourteen minutes in, Ryan is still re-litigating the penalty clause in Ace's contract — a topic Legal already closed last month — and none of today's three real agenda items (root cause, which frames need re-labeling, whether Friday's date holds) has been touched. David isn't on this call. Sixteen minutes remain.

prompts.frame: 肯定對方問題的重要性 → 講出已經花的時間（具體數字）→ 提出待辦清單並給它一個未來的位置 → 把時間拉回到今天真正要決定的事。
prompts.model: “Ryan, that's a fair point and I don't want to lose it — if Ace misses SLA again, leverage matters a lot. But we're fourteen minutes into a thirty-minute meeting and we haven't touched root cause yet. Let's park that and come back to it if we have time — right now I want to protect the last ten minutes for owners and dates on the fourteen thousand frames. Can I add the penalty clause to the parking lot and set up ten minutes with you and Phoebe tomorrow? That way it gets the real attention it deserves, and today we actually get through the three items on this agenda.”
prompts.q: Ryan: “But the penalty clause matters — if Ace misses SLA again we lose leverage. Can we finish this discussion?”
prompts.say: 出聲講完整段（目標 35 秒）。第一句禁止是「This is not related」，第一句要先肯定 Ryan 的點有價值。

prompts.frame: 承認這也是合理的問題 → 用「新資訊還是舊討論」逼出範圍 → 給一個小範圍的承諾（誰、什麼時候）→ 把大會拉回三項待辦的分類階段。
prompts.model: “It is important, Ivy, and I don't want to wave it off. Let me ask this: is this new information, or are we re-opening something we already know? … Okay, so what you actually want is the root-cause breakdown, not a live debate on it right now. That's item one on today's list, and I'll get Phoebe to walk through it in the next five minutes — just the summary, not the full investigation. We have three items and twelve minutes — let's triage, not solve. If you need the full detail after that, I'll take the deep-dive offline with just you and Phoebe so it doesn't eat into everyone else's time.”
prompts.q: Ivy: “Wait, before we move on — I also want to understand why the error rate jumped, this seems really important too.”
prompts.say: 練習「擋掉合理但會拖時間的追問」。禁用「we don't have time」、「maybe later」。

prompts.frame: 承認時間確實到了 → 立刻把已經達成的共識念出來 → 指定負責人與明確日期 → 提早結束並肯定大家的時間。
prompts.model: “We are basically out of time, but let me lock in what we just agreed before we lose the room. Root cause: Ace's two new labelers this week, confirmed by Phoebe. Scope: fourteen thousand of the fifty thousand frames need re-labeling. Owner and date: Ryan talks to Ace about a corrective plan by Thursday, Phoebe re-labels the fourteen thousand frames by next Wednesday, and I'll confirm to Simulation whether Friday's handoff holds by end of day tomorrow. Ryan, the contract clause is still on the parking lot — you and I will cover that tomorrow at ten. Thanks, everyone — that's a clean thirty minutes.”
prompts.q: Phoebe: “Okay, we're basically out of time — should we just send a follow-up email with everything?”
prompts.say: 練習「散會收尾」。目標讓每個 action 都有人名跟日期，禁止用「I will send follow-up later」這種空泛收尾。

fixes.bad: Let's discuss this problem more deeply because it's very important.
fixes.good: Let's take this offline — it matters, but it's not for this room.
fixes.note: Register（語氣強度）：問題很重要不代表要留在大會裡討論，主持人講 more deeply 聽起來像在鼓勵繼續發散，把重要的事移到對的場合才是專業的收斂動作。

fixes.bad: We are already talking this topic since ten minutes.
fixes.good: We've been talking about this topic for ten minutes.
fixes.note: Grammar（時態＋介系詞）：「從過去持續到現在」要用現在完成進行式 we've been talking，不能用現在式；talk 後面要加 about；since 接時間點，for 才接時間長度（for ten minutes）。

fixes.bad: This point I think is more important than that point.
fixes.good: I think this point matters more than that one.
fixes.note: Word order（語序）：中文習慣把主題放最前面，但英文要先講 I think，再講判斷內容，主詞倒裝聽起來像逐字翻譯；重複的 that point 也該換成 that one。

fixes.bad: Everyone must to give feedback before we close.
fixes.good: Everyone needs to give feedback before we close.
fixes.note: Grammar（情態動詞）：must 後面直接加原形動詞，不能加 to；要用 to-不定詞的講法就換成 needs to、has to。

fixes.bad: Let's back to the main topic.
fixes.good: Let's get back to the main topic.
fixes.note: Collocation（動詞搭配）：back 是副詞不是動詞，中間一定要有動詞 get（或 go、come）才能構成「回到」的意思，這是台灣人最常漏掉的小詞。

challenge:
今天在你主持或參加的任何一場會議中做這一件事：當議題偏題超過兩分鐘，主動喊停並丟出待辦清單 ——

“Let's park that and come back to it if we have time — right now I want to protect time for ___.”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：回想這週一場「明顯偏題」的會議，重新主持一次開場到拉回主題的過程。

  • 第一句要先講出「我們已經花多少時間在這一項」的具體數字
  • 中段要出現至少一個「這是待辦清單，不是句點」的句型，讓被打斷的人不覺得被否定
  • 結尾要講出接下來會保留多少時間給哪一件事
  • 禁用：let's discuss more、not related、we don't have time、whatever、maybe later
check: 議題偏題的時候，我是任由它發散，還是主動喊出「這是待辦清單」把它收起來？
我有沒有把剩下的時間攤開講出具體數字，而不是含糊地說「我們快沒時間了」？
散會前，我有沒有當場把共識念出來、指定負責人跟日期，而不是等會後才補寄？
